content.content: Did you know that "I'll Make Love To You" by Boyz II Men, released in 1994, became the longest-reigning number one hit in the US at that time, tying Whitney Houston's "I Will Always Love You" and eventually breaking that record? The song, written and produced by Kenneth "Babyface" Edmonds, dominated the charts for a remarkable 14 weeks, solidifying its place as one of the most iconic R&B ballads of the 1990s.
content.title: I'll Make Love To You

alternatives.text: Did you know that "I'll Make Love To You" by Boyz II Men held the record for the longest-running number one single on the Billboard Hot 100 chart in the 1990s? Spending a total of 14 weeks at the top spot, the soulful R&B ballad became a massive hit worldwide and solidified Boyz II Men's status as one of the most successful vocal groups of the era. The song's romantic lyrics and smooth harmonies struck a chord with audiences, making it a timeless classic that continues to be a favorite slow jam for many music lovers.
